note: A card where the sheet's loudest numbers are the model's general lean toward decisions and moneyline gaps my reads don't back (Kamaka, Tanzilovi), so most of it is a pass. I bet only two decision props with a fight-specific reason, small, because both rest on the finish model rather than a proven moneyline edge. Weigh-ins: Souza, Ribeiro and Bonfim (7.5 lb) missed; none touches these bets. Allen and Duncan both made weight.

picks.reasoning: Five rounds between a grinder who wins late and a striker who has never been submitted: Allen's path is control and a decision, and Duncan's knockouts come early against lesser opposition, not against a durable top-five middleweight. FanDuel's 40% for the distance looks low for this matchup; I make it about half.

Harris is the deserved favourite (about 73%), but Frye has never been finished (his only UFC fight went the distance) and comes in 15 lb lighter at 246, so a Harris win on the cards is likelier than FanDuel's 14.5%. Small stake: heavyweight finish rates make this a long shot either way.
